2.  The present revision has been preferred by the revisionist before this Court with the following prayers :-
"It is, therefore, most respectfully prayed that this Hon'ble Court may graciously be pleased to set aside the order dated 22.11.2023 passed by learned Judge, Children Court, Fatehpur in Criminal Appeal No. 43 of 2023 relating to Case Crime No. 56 of 2023, U/S 376(3) I.P.C. and 5/6 POCSO Act (State vs. Juvenile X) P.S. Asothar,
District Fatehpur and order dated 20.09.2023 passed by learned Principal Juvenile -X vs State Of Up 3 Others on 9 January, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/156957716/
1 Magistrate, Juvenile Justice Board, Fatehpur.
And further prayed this Hon'ble Court during pendency of the instant revision this Hon'ble Court may graciously be pleased to release the applicant / revisionist on bail in Case No. 88 of 2021 relating to Case Crime No. 56 of 2023, U/S. 376(3) I.P.C. and 5/6 POCSO Act (State vs. Juvenile X) P.S. Asothar, District Fatehpur.
And/or pass such another and further order which is this Hon'ble Court may deem fit and proper under the facts and circumstances of the case."
